10:43.text: And among them are some who look at you, but can you guide the blind - even though they see not?

10:44.text: Truly! Allâh wrongs not mankind in aught; but mankind wrong themselves.

10:45.text: And on the Day when He shall gather
as if they had not stayed
(in the life of this world and graves)
but an hour of a day. They will recognise each other. Ruined indeed will be those who denied the Meeting with Allâh, and were not guided.

10:46.text: (in your lifetime, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
some of what We promise them
, or We cause you to die - still unto Us is their return, and moreover, Allâh is Witness over what they used to do.

10:47.text: there is a Messenger; when their Messenger comes, the matter will be judged between them with justice, and they will not be wronged.

10:48.text: And they say: "When will be this promise
(the torment or the Day of Resurrection)

10:49.text: : "I have no power over any harm or profit to myself except what Allâh may will. For every Ummah
, there is a term appointed; when their term comes, neither can they delay it nor can they advance it an hour

10:50.text: Say: "Tell me, if His torment should come to you by night or by day, which portion thereof would the Mujrimûn

10:51.text: Is it then that when it has actually befallen, you will believe in it? What! Now

10:52.text: Then it will be said to them who wronged themselves: "Taste you the everlasting torment! Are you recompensed
save what you used to earn?"

10:53.text: (i.e. the torment and the establishment of the Hour - the Day of Resurrection)
?" Say: "Yes! By my Lord! It is the very truth! and you cannot escape it!"
